proof.text: For each fixed target M, apply CategoryTheory.signedDerivedInternalHom_exact at the same independent universes. Its functor Prod.sectL _ M composed with derivedInternalHomOfUniverses is definitionally the flipped curried Hom functor. Retain its coherent CommShift structure and triangulatedness, forgetting only the additional normalization equations.

For each fixed source K, choose the normalized homCommShift structure and use hom_isTriangulated from the recorded independent-universe shift module. The abbreviation hom is precisely the curried Hom functor at op K. Combine these two variablewise statements by conjunction.

title: Independent-universe exactness of ringed internal Hom
statement: For a site with independent object and morphism universes, a sheaf of commutative rings and its module derived category, derivedInternalHomOfUniverses is triangulated covariantly in the second variable and contravariantly in the first variable, with the corresponding normalized shifts.
